appearance.title: Appearance
appearance.subtitle: Customize how the platform looks and feels.

security.title: Security
security.subtitle: Manage your email, password, and active sessions.
security.emailHint: Your login email address. To change it, contact support.
security.passwordHint: You will receive a reset link at your registered email address.
security.passwordResetSentConfirm: A password reset link has been sent to {email}.
security.passwordResetError: Failed to send reset email. Please try again.

twoFa.title: Two-factor authentication
twoFa.subtitle: Add an extra layer of security to your account using an authenticator app.
twoFa.scanQr: Scan this QR code with your authenticator app
twoFa.enterCode: Enter the 6-digit code from your authenticator app to confirm
twoFa.backupCodesHint: Store these codes somewhere safe. Each can be used once if you lose access to your authenticator.
twoFa.disableConfirm: Enter your current TOTP code to disable 2FA

security.changeEmailHint: Email change is not yet available. Support for this feature is coming soon.
security.sessionsHint: View and revoke active login sessions across all your devices.

notifications.title: Notifications
notifications.subtitle: Choose how and when you receive notifications.

unsavedChanges.title: Unsaved changes
unsavedChanges.description: You have unsaved changes. If you leave, your changes will be lost.

sessionLifetimes.title: Session lifetimes
sessionLifetimes.subtitle: How long a session may go unused before the person has to sign in again, by role and by app. Every refresh starts the clock again.
sessionLifetimes.shortestWins: A person with several roles gets the shortest lifetime among them.
sessionLifetimes.fallback: A person none of whose roles is listed gets {value}.
sessionLifetimes.neverChanged: Nothing has been changed since the defaults were set.
sessionLifetimes.appliesFrom: A change applies to sessions signed in or refreshed after it. An open session keeps its expiry until its next refresh; to end sessions now, revoke them.
sessionLifetimes.saved: {n, plural, one {One lifetime saved.} other {# lifetimes saved.}}
sessionLifetimes.failed: We could not load session lifetimes.
